translations.web: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Wail, ‘Alas for the day!’
translations.bsb: “Son of man, prophesy and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: Wail, ‘Alas for that day!’
translations.kjv: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Howl ye, Woe worth the day!
translations.asv: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Wail ye, Alas for the day!
